description: Twelve Data helps you look up market data and inspect it without leaving ChatGPT. Ask for a quote snapshot, view real-time or historical price action in an interactive chart, search the endpoint catalog, and run market data workflows for stocks, ETFs, funds, forex, crypto, and more. The app is read-only, so it does not place trades or move money.

defaultPrompt: Get the latest quote and today's change for a stock AAPL
Show daily time series for AAPL for the last 30 days
What is the RSI for TSLA?
